title: Portfolio, consolidation and operations
subtitle: Forty-four repositories, six substrates and one person. What can be merged, what has been built twice, where the line runs that must not be crossed — and the system that keeps the whole thing running without falling apart.
scope: The map covers **43 repositories read from beginning to end** — README, documentation, code, workflows and git history. Nine of them joined on 12 September 2026, and all nine are public. One more, read the same way, is temporarily withdrawn from the map until a security gap the audit found in it is fixed — a credential in `quorum`'s history stays valid until it is rotated, and that repository has been public since 1 September. The account holds more repositories than this: others are public, not archived and **are not here**, among them `DeepDiveInto_CSharp_Dictionaries_presentation` (3 stars). A repository reaches the map when someone has actually read it — not when it exists.
